_comment: IMPORTED records summarise publicly reported events (research publication / news reports) with source links. They have NOT been cross-checked against an official landslide or flood inventory and must not be used as evaluation labels until they are. SYNTHETIC records are fabricated for interface demonstration only and describe no real event. No casualty figures are included.

incidents.title: Kedarnath flash flood and debris flow (June 2013)
incidents.description: Extreme rainfall in mid-June 2013 coincided with a breach of the moraine-dammed Chorabari lake above Kedarnath, producing a flash flood and debris flow down the Mandakini valley. Summary of a peer-reviewed publication; see source.
incidents.source_name: Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences, 15, 1597 (2015)
incidents.notes: Event spanned 16–17 June 2013 and affected the whole valley; point location is indicative only.

incidents.title: Landslide at Gaurikund on the Kedarnath route (August 2023)
incidents.description: News reports described a landslide during heavy rain at Gaurikund on the Kedarnath yatra route, with people reported missing and search operations under way.
incidents.notes: Date is the date of the media report; the event was reported overnight before it.

incidents.title: Cloudburst on the Kedarnath route near Lincholi / Bhimbali (July 2024)
incidents.description: Media reports described a cloudburst affecting the Kedarnath trek route, with the Mandakini in spate and pilgrims stranded; later reports linked landslide debris near Lincholi to the event.
incidents.notes: Location approximate (trek-route locality). Cross-check with official records before use.
